fields.summary_ko.0: Texas Instruments (TXN) rose 91.2% year-to-date as of November 10, 2026, significantly outpacing the S&P 500 (up 11.4%), and annual EPS increased approximately 41% from $5.47 to $7.71 as of September 2026.
fields.summary_ko.1: As of September 2026, the P/E ratio rose from 33.1 to 36.0, and at the closing price on November 10, it reached 38.6x, higher than the S&P 500's 22.3x. As of September 2026, annual operating income was $854 million, still lower than $1.07 billion in September 2022.
